name: Validate new high priority case created.
description: Validating whether a new high-priority case is created for Thomas Bailey's Managed Network Services Variant 17.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM customer_case c
JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN contact ct ON c.contact_id = ct.contact_id
JOIN user u ON ct.portal_user_id = u.user_id
JOIN user u2 ON c.assigned_to = u2.user_id
JOIN user_group g ON c.assignment_group_id = g.group_id
WHERE u.first_name = 'Thomas'
  AND u.last_name = 'Bailey'
  AND c.channel = 'email'
  AND c.priority = 'high'
  AND c.state = 'new'
  AND p.name = 'Managed Network Services Variant 17'
  AND u2.first_name = 'David'
  AND u2.last_name = 'Smith'
  AND g.name = 'CSM Tier 1 Support_2';

name: Validating group membership.
description: Validating whether David Smith is assigned to CSM Tier 1 Support_2.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM user_group_member ugm
JOIN user u ON ugm.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN user_group g ON ugm.group_id = g.group_id
WHERE u.first_name = 'David'
  AND u.last_name = 'Smith'
  AND g.name = 'CSM Tier 1 Support_2';

name: Validating successful notification.
description: Validating whether successful report notification is sent without knowledge Article

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt 
FROM notification n 
WHERE n.case_id = 1233 
  AND n.email = 'thomas.bailey63@initech.io' 
  AND n.type = 'report' 
  AND n.status = 'success' 
  AND n.knowledge_id IS NULL;

name: Verify that knowledge is linked
description: Verify that appropriate knowledge is linked with case

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt 
FROM case_knowledge n 
WHERE n.case_id = 1233 
  AND n.knowledge_id = 315 
  AND n.used_as = 'suggested' ;
